intro: Grelin's Report is a dispatch written by Grelin Whitebeard detailing the Frostmane troll situation in Coldridge Valley. Entrusted to an adventurer rather than a novice apprentice, it serves as the official link between the scouts guarding Anvilmar and Senir Whitebeard stationed in Kharanos.

p: Written after observing the Frostmane trolls in Coldridge Valley, Grelin's Report concludes that they pose no large threat and can be dealt with by the Mountaineers already stationed there and mercenaries paid from Senate funds. Rather than trusting his fumbling apprentice with such vital intelligence, Grelin enlists a capable traveler to carry the document through the trogg-infested Coldridge Pass. The paper acts as an official pass through Mountaineer Thalos's blockade, proving the bearer travels on urgent business to the wider snowy expanse of Dun Morogh.

When delivered to Senir Whitebeard at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, the report provides critical field updates intended for Ironforge. Senir notes with amused resignation that his brother invoked King Magni Bronzebeard's name liberally throughout the text. Grelin claims the King's sanction for the action, and Senir expects that appeal to royal authority to ruffle some feathers in the Ironforge Senate.
